name: temp_buffers
description: Sets the maximum number of temporary buffers allocated per database session for operations on temporary tables and sorts.
symptoms: Excessive disk I/O during temp table usage
Query timeouts due to spilling to disk
tuning_tips: Increase only for sessions expected to use large temporary tables; monitor per-session memory usage and avoid setting too high, as memory is not shared across sessions and each buffer consumes ~64 bytes overhead plus 8kB when used.
